_doc: Scout research eval set (opt-in SCOUT_EVAL=1). Each case is one owner research question sent to the real lead; the lead routes it. kind = the research shape (quick lookup, technical docs, deep report, academic, market); it only groups the report. No expected answer: the run is scored on a completed scout, cited URLs that resolve, cost and latency.
